label: The Artist
tagline: A loop that allows the artifact to be wrong, for a while.
cluster_explainer: The Artist uses the engine as a place where the work is allowed to be unfinished — the loop is the room where the next attempt is tried without committing it to a viewer.
demo_highlights: Torus reads as continuous flow — the artifact is allowed to return to itself, revised, before it ever has to be final
Smoke preset favors the unresolved — every frame is allowed to look like a draft the artist hasn't signed yet
Mid-band reactance tracks the body of the take where the artistic center lives, not the transient hits that would turn the demo into a music video
Smooth envelope (0.6) lets a fragment of the work sit unfinished for a while — the engine waits for the next attempt rather than committing the previous one
No 'final' preset, no 'mastered' frame: the loop is a workshop, not a stage
